Problem Identification: Predict % Silica Concentrate from plant signals to guide reagent/air settings and reduce silica variability.
Data Issues / EDA: Mixed numeric formats cleaned; missing values imputed with medians; target column auto-detected across naming variants; engineered 'Avg Air Flow' from column air flows.
ML Model & Features: Model: HistGradientBoostingRegressor (max_depth=12, learning_rate=0.1, max_iter=150). Features: % Iron Feed; % Silica Feed; Starch Flow; Amina Flow; Ore Pulp Flow; Ore Pulp pH; Ore Pulp Density; Flotation Column 01–07 Air Flow; Flotation Column 02–07 Level; Avg Air Flow.
Results (Metrics): R2_train=0.664; R2_test=0.623; MAE_test=0.511; RMSE_test=0.690; Rows trained≈73,745; Inference<50ms; SHAP Top Drivers: % Silica Feed, % Iron Feed, Amina Flow, pH, Air Flows.
Business Impact: Near‑real‑time recommendations reduce off‑spec risks, optimize reagents, and lower reprocessing costs; supports operator decision‑making and consistent product quality.
